newsitem.title: UK: Lex Service says year has strong start.
newsitem.headline: Lex Service says year has strong start.

text.p: British vehicle leasing company Lex Service Plc said on Friday it had a strong start to the year, with profit growth in its main businesses.
"The year has started well for Lex," chairman Trevor Chinn said in a statement from the company's annual general meeting.

"The businesses which we are building from a strong leadership position have all increased their profits," he added, highlighting the performance of its vehicle leasing operations in the first quarter.
The company said its Lex Retail business had grown in sales and profit in its on-going dealerships, although overall profit was lower than the year-ago period.
"Lex Transfleet and Lex Commercials continue to feel the effect of weak truck demand," Chinn said.
The company added that it had continued to reduce its capital employed and net debt with a corresponding reduction in interest charges.
Lex shares firmed 2.5p to 332 by 1200 GMT.
